reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "loki Remove deprecated config `-s3.sse-encryption` in favor or `-s3.sse.*` settings", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: The removed `-s3.sse-encryption` config is no longer honoured; S3 server-side encryption must be configured with the `-s3.sse.*` settings.

proposed.statement: The deprecated Loki config `-s3.sse-encryption` is removed in favor of the `-s3.sse.*` settings.
